title: Measurement of the Water Solubility in the Gas Phase of the Ethane + Water Binary System near Hydrate Forming Conditions
experimental_method: Static-analytic method with vapour sampling (Rolsi), GC with TCD (water) and FID (ethane); water calibration with an exponential dilutor.
uncertainties_stated: T +/-0.02 K (bath control +/-0.01 K); P +/-0.5 kPa (0-2.5 MPa), +/-5 kPa (2.5-38 MPa); ethane calibration +/-1%. Uncertainty on water mole fraction not stated in the captured text.

not_extracted_tables.Table 3: calculated pressures from a correlation / EoS
not_extracted_tables.Table 7: calculated (not measured) water mole fraction in the aqueous phase (Henry-law model); the capture holds this table in several identical duplicates

quality_remarks: Table 1 prints the ethane critical pressure as 48.08 MPa (should be 4.808 MPa), not extracted.

Table 6 (not extracted) lists temperatures 283.08, 288.11 ... 318.12 K, which differ from the measured isotherms in Table 4 (278.08-303.11 K): 308-318 K are not measured here and 278.08 is missing; also 283.08 vs 283.11 K.
Table 4 dy/% decimals vary in the print (e.g. 1.7, 0.3, 3.50) and the printed Dy for 278.08 K/2.71 MPa is 0.00; kept as printed.
Row count 54 matches the printed table. The water mole fractions decrease monotonically with pressure along every isotherm (script check). Ranges match the abstract (278.08-303.11 K).
Hydrate rows: the abstract states that vapour-hydrate equilibria were measured but the table does not flag which points; not marked.
extraction_notes: Header '103yw,exp' written as '10^3 yw,exp'; 'Dy' kept; Unicode minus replaced by ASCII minus.
